home.title: Arkidi Platform

home.welcome_body: The public portal of the Archdiocese of Kigali Ecclesiastical Management System. Browse general information about the archdiocese here; staff and administrators can sign in to manage records.
home.discover_subtitle: Read-only information available to all visitors.
home.cta_title: Are you staff or an administrator?
home.cta_body: Sign in to access the platform's internal tools for managing parishes, records, finances and more.
home.footer: Archdiocese of Kigali Ecclesiastical Management System • Arkidi Platform

sections.diocese_description: Discover the parishes and ecclesiastical territory of the Archdiocese of Kigali through our public directory.
sections.faithful_description: Public information about the community and pastoral care offered across the archdiocese.
sections.sacraments_description: General information about the administration of Baptism, Confirmation and Matrimony.
sections.ministries_description: Overview of the clergy, religious and pastoral ministries serving the local Church.
sections.archives_description: Historical records and documentation preserved by the Diocesan Archives.
sections.geography_description: Explore the geographical footprint and territorial organization of the archdiocese.
